description: This file implements the VideoResourceUpdater class responsible for managing video frame resources, including hardware and software planes, and rendering video frames as quads in a graphics compositor. It handles resource allocation, recycling, copying, and integration with GPU and shared memory systems.

classes.name: VideoFrameExternalResources
classes.description: Holds external resources (textures, shared bitmaps) associated with a video frame, including resource type, size, offset, multiplier, bits per channel, and resource list.

classes.name: VideoResourceUpdater::PlaneResource
classes.description: Represents a resource for a video plane, either software or hardware, with methods for reference management and identification.

classes.name: VideoResourceUpdater::SoftwarePlaneResource
classes.description: A software implementation of PlaneResource, managing shared memory bitmap for software video frames.

classes.name: VideoResourceUpdater::HardwarePlaneResource
classes.description: A hardware implementation of PlaneResource, managing shared image mailbox and GL texture target.

classes.name: VideoResourceUpdater::HardwarePlaneResource::ScopedTexture
classes.description: RAII class for managing shared image access scope as a GL texture.

classes.name: VideoResourceUpdater
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing video frame resources, including allocation, recycling, copying, and rendering as quads in the compositor.

methods.name: CreateExternalResourcesFromVideoFrame
methods.description: Creates external resources (hardware or software) from a given VideoFrame.

methods.name: CreateForHardwarePlanes
methods.description: Creates external resources for hardware-accelerated video frames with textures.

methods.name: CreateForSoftwarePlanes
methods.description: Creates external resources for software video frames, converting to shared memory bitmaps.

methods.name: RecycleOrAllocateResource
methods.description: Recycles an existing resource if compatible, or allocates a new one.

methods.name: AllocateResource
methods.description: Allocates a new resource for a video plane.

methods.name: CopyHardwarePlane
methods.description: Copies video frame data into a hardware resource via GL.

methods.name: ObtainFrameResources
methods.description: Obtains and assigns resources for a video frame.

methods.name: ReleaseFrameResources
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the current video frame.

methods.name: AppendQuads
methods.description: Appends rendering quads for the video frame into the render pass.

methods.name: OnMemoryDump
methods.description: Provides memory dump information for resource tracking.
